name: Simiah
tagline: Nimble, grippy, and quick to climb
description: Ape-like beings with prehensile feet and tails, skilled at climbing, Simiah names are light and quick, suited to folk always on the move.

features.name: Natural Climber
features.description: You have advantage on Agility Rolls that involve balancing and climbing.

features.name: Nimble
features.description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion at character creation.
